method.confirmed_hoa: Only from a green source that itself asserts the association: Boulder HoaArcRef=Yes, DC Condo Approval Lots, Franklin/Hamilton CONDO polygons. Label 'HOA (recorded)' or 'condo association'.
method.built_boundary: 1) green plat polygon (Sacramento, Scottsdale, Spokane, Gilbert*, Columbus, Hamilton, Boulder); 2) green or public-domain registry name: IRS BMF activity 401 / NTEE L50 (public domain), CO SOS (public domain); grey registries (TX TREC, VA DPOR) only as an internal matching hint, never shipped; 3) fuzzy name + ZIP/city match between registry name and plat name; 4) where the plat record carries a book/page or instrument, store it as a citation for the CC&R (the recorded declaration itself is read by the user at the recorder). Output kind 'HOA candidate (name match)', confidence medium; geometry is the plat, never a drawn HOA line.
method.must_stay_possible: Any plat polygon without a matched registry name or recorded-HOA flag: 'subdivision plat (possible covenants - not confirmed HOA)'. Any name match: 'possible HOA, name match only'. Absence of data: 'no open HOA data', never 'non-HOA'. Master/sub-association nesting and multi-plat HOAs cannot be inferred.
method.never: No polygons from grey/red HOA layers, civic neighborhood organizations, OSM, or hand-drawn lines; no contact fields.
